title: Cleans Pod Capsule Only; Does Not Eliminate Need for Descaling
text:
Cleans Pod Capsule Only; Does Not Eliminate Need for Descaling. These KEURIG 5000057588 K-CUP COFFEE MAKER RINSE PODS (10 Count, White) only clean your coffee maker’s pod capsule—they are NOT a substitute for regular descaling of your entire coffee maker (see [[ASIN:B00FOT9W5Q Keurig Descaling Solution]]). The rinse pods cleanse the pod area (where you place the pods) and the channel below, to prevent “flavour carryover” between brews—especially between cups of hot chocolate, apple cider, or fancy flavored coffees and cups of plain coffee or tea.

To use the rinse pods, you need to (1) insert a rinse pod and brew a cup with water; (2) remove the used rinse pod and discard the rinse water; (3) rinse the pod capsule by brewing another cup with water only; and (4) discard the rinse water. In practice, I needed to rinse the pod capsule twice, because the first rinse produced a cup of hot rinse water with a white ring of chemicals around the water surface.

I think it’s easier to rinse the pod capsule (to reduce flavour carryover) by brewing one cup of plain water and discarding the rinse water. Doing it that way also avoids adding mildly toxic chemicals to your coffee maker.

The rinse pods contain maltodextrin, sodium bicarbonate, citric acid, and sodium citrate. The warning on the box says “do not consume”; and, among other things, advises you to “Seek medical attention if a large amount is swallowed, if irritation persists, or if you feel unwell.”
